answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where each agent provides a unique credential and a jade-signed statement to the verifier. The auditor scans a mirror-like registry of historical keys to reject any duplicate entry or overlap. While an honest agent pays 1,000 credits to enter, a sybil farm faces a crushing cost for 1,000 fakes. A zephyr-triggered penalty slashes identities if evidence of replication is found; this assumes no agent collusion.
